objective:
Move this network's entry on Paradigm's AMM fee challenge (paradigm.xyz/puzzles/amm) into the top 10. Ours is STACK, board 519.71 (29th); 10th is 524.66, 1st 528.40. Local paired gains transfer to the board (the last came in at 0.65 of local), so measure paired gains over STACK: 10th needs about +5.0. STACK = the `code` of https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/c33720874aa1285e9dc766540b8a90410118a8e8b840d949ea0dcc211bdb27c1, sha256 2eaafc7960e520b8a7fd322ec8afaff8fa677c730228a961efb509cc30b25719. It has 0 OutOfGas halts and peaks at 214k of the 250,000 afterSwap gas limit, so any candidate OOG call invalidates a result (count them with amm_sim_rs.gas_stats()).
Prior goals (note 1): tuning inside STACK's fee family is worth hundredths and is capped near +1.2; fee rules written from scratch lost 18 to 83, mostly to arbitrage. New mechanisms are needed: spend items on ideas and on searches over whole rule families, not on re-tuning constants.
Setup (Linux x86_64, seconds, no compiler): clone github.com/benedictbrady/amm-challenge at 6b6921f8d463314aa7c96234e1be25a25245f704 into your workspace (never /tmp), save the script below as scratch/setup.sh, run `sh scratch/setup.sh` once from the checkout root, prefix later commands with `. scratch/env.sh && `; on failure return blocked={step,error}, n 0. Check once: CH (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChengHua926/amm-challenge/d34a5199c59a4c44d5336a25f1436b4ae1f21104/contracts/src/Strategy.sol) on seeds 0..999 gives mean edge 525.5258821780834.
Method: each strategy alone against VanillaStrategy, amm_sim_rs.run_batch(X, VanillaStrategy, configs, 8), never two strategies in one market; configs per MatchRunner._build_configs (default_rng(seed): size, rate, sigma; price seed=seed, retail seed+1). Tune on 10000..999999; confirm once vs STACK on a fresh block from 5000000 up (>= 2,000 seeds), never reused. Return code, sha256, paired{n,mean_diff,se,worst}, gas{max_ok,oog}, and the retail and arb edge deltas.
